title: Bodytonic Pilates

services.name: Studio Classes
services.desc: Bodytonic Pilates online virtual classes are much more than a prerecorded workout. Our virtual classes are all live-streamed and offer the same custom-tailored and individualized benefits that you receive in our studio classes. If you are working from home, traveling, or looking for a way to save time, our virtual classes are the perfect option for you. Equipment : Required - exercise mat. Recommended - free weights - exercise bands - sliders - Pilates ring. At Bodytonic, we understand the challenge of balancing busy work and family schedules while also attending to personal health and wellness goals. While we do have a 24-hour cancelation policy, we also have a unique make-up class system

explain.meaning: As many classes as you like during the plan's period.
